name: govuk-webmcp
description: Independent experimental WebMCP prototype research and local implementation workspace

scripts.build: npm run catalogue:build && npm run catalogue:validate && tsc && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
scripts.test:browser:edge: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=msedge playwright test
scripts.test: npm run research:verify && npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
